aliases.description: Alternate labels retained by normalization; not guaranteed globally unique.

canonical_name.description: Canonical display label; not a unique key.

cik.description: Optional SEC CIK string; retain leading zeroes.

description.description: Optional entity description, sometimes containing a parent category and family definition.

entity_type.description: Node class; offering families retain Input, Product or Technology classes.
